details: Global banking giant JPMorgan has filed to launch JLTXX, a new on-chain money market fund that will operate on the Ethereum blockchain. This fund will invest in U.S. treasury bills, bonds, and notes, signaling further institutional adoption of blockchain technology for traditional finance.
title: JPMorgan Files for Tokenized Money Market Fund on Ethereum

details: Michael Terpin, a notable crypto evangelist, foresees Bitcoin reaching $1 million but anticipates a preceding drop to the $50,000-$60,000 range by October. He also projects that "AI tokens" will outperform Bitcoin over the next three years, aligning with the 2028 presidential election cycle for a new Bitcoin bull market.
title: 'Godfather of Crypto' Predicts $1M Bitcoin, Expects Short-Term Dip

details: Bitcoin is targeting the $85,000 level in May after clearing key on-chain resistance. However, a higher-than-expected April CPI report (3.8%) and a pushed-back forecast for Federal Reserve rate cuts to late 2027 are creating macroeconomic headwinds for speculative assets. The upcoming CLARITY Act markup also remains a significant market factor.
title: Bitcoin Aims for $85K in May Amid Inflation & Fed Rate Cut Delays

details: On May 12, 2026, the ETH/BTC ratio reached a 10-month low, indicating a persistent trend of investors reallocating capital within the crypto market, favoring Bitcoin over Ethereum. While Bitcoin saw a slight decrease, Ethereum's decline was more pronounced.
title: ETH/BTC Ratio Hits 10-Month Low as Capital Shifts to Bitcoin

details: MicroStrategy made its smallest weekly Bitcoin acquisition of 2026, purchasing 535 BTC for approximately $43 million between May 5-11. This slowdown in accumulation, while still reinforcing long-term conviction, suggests a potential shift in their aggressive buying strategy.
title: MicroStrategy Reduces Bitcoin Accumulation Pace in Latest Buy

details: Ethereum (ETH) is exhibiting bullish accumulation patterns below the $2,400 threshold, with a potential breakout anticipated. The impending approval of the CLARITY Act is seen as a major catalyst for a broader altcoin rally, and ETH futures open interest has surged 38% in three months, reflecting increased speculative interest.
title: Ethereum Shows Bullish Accumulation Below $2,400; Clarity Act Eyed

details: AlphaPepe has started its Tier-1 exchange listing roadshow after raising over $1.18 million in presale with 8,500+ holders and 3,000+ AlphaSwap AI DEX demo users, alongside completing a BlockSAFU security audit. Concurrently, XRP price predictions are targeting $5.00, driven by anticipation of the CLARITY Act, ETF inflows, and institutional demand.
title: AlphaPepe Begins Exchange Listing Roadshow; XRP Eyes $5.00
